name: Dog Facts
evidence: Current kinduff host dog-api.kinduff.com redirects to dogapi.dog, whose Terms section 2 permits personal non-commercial use only. The homepage describes free access and paid teaching, but that does not override the narrower API licence. Leave discovery pending explicit commercial gateway permission.

name: NekosBest
evidence: Official Terms updated February 17, 2026 explicitly prohibit commercial use, rehosting/reselling/monetizing content and public redistribution of cached API responses. Fully free/no-key marketing and valid HTTP200 metadata do not grant commercial gateway rights.

name: Dicebear Avatars
evidence: Official hosted HTTP API guide limits free public API use to non-commercial purposes and directs commercial users to self-host. Permissive avatar style/software licences do not grant use of the hosted commercial gateway without permission.
